s.note: the German dentist who pours his own beer
s.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast and 250ml warm water and prove an hour. Shape 8 pretzels, dip in simmering water with 3 tbsp bicarb, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with grainy mustard and butter.

s.note: riding through Texas on the bounty trail
s.how: Slice 500g partly frozen beef topside very thin. Marinate overnight in 60ml soy, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, cracked pepper and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Dry on racks at 70C for 4 hours.

m.note: Dr Schultz and the German legend he tells Django
m.how: Simmer a jar of sauerkraut with 125ml white wine, a grated apple and 1 tsp caraway for 20 minutes. Grill 8 bratwurst slowly until browned. Boil 800g potatoes and toss in butter.

w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 80g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon in a dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over. Bake at 190C for 40 minutes and serve with cream.

d.note: two beers at the empty saloon
d.how: Chill four 500ml bottles of German lager. Pour hard into tall mugs so a thick head forms. Raise them to a free man and a good dentist.
